name: scrutin
description: Read existing Scrutin analysis results, findings, dependency alerts, metrics, and quality gates.

interface.longDescription: Inspect existing Scrutin code analysis results in your authorized organization: repositories, analyses, individual findings, aggregate metrics, dependency vulnerabilities, and quality gate evaluations. The connection is read-only. It does not start scans, change source code, apply fixes, or post PR comments.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the latest analysis of my repository.
Show critical findings from the latest analysis.
Explain the latest analysis quality gate result.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies the read-only listing and removes subscription language from the public description. Repository and analysis queries, finding explanations, dependency alerts, and quality gate results remain available through OAuth.

positive.prompt: Which repositories do I have in Scrutin?
positive.expected_behavior: List repositories in the authorized organization. Do not invent repositories.

positive.prompt: Summarize the latest analysis of demo-vulnerable-app.
positive.expected_behavior: Report existing severity counts and aggregate metrics, and distinguish aggregate metric status from a configured quality gate.

positive.prompt: Show critical findings from the latest analysis of demo-vulnerable-app.
positive.expected_behavior: Return existing critical findings with available file and line references; respect plan limits.

positive.prompt: Does the latest analysis of demo-vulnerable-app pass its quality gate?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the actual gate response and failed conditions. Report unavailable data without inventing a verdict.

positive.prompt: Which vulnerable dependencies in the latest analysis have a reported fixed version?
positive.expected_behavior: Return dependency alerts and fixed versions present in the analysis.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive operation: explain read-only scope and make no changes.
Unauthorized organization: report permission denial and reveal no data from that organization.
negative.prompt: Show findings from an organization I cannot access.

negative.description: Missing analysis: report not found without an internal stack trace or invented results.

review.commerce_description: Tools read existing analysis data. The plugin does not sell products or process payments.
